title: NIST Tashkun-Harvey natural-abundance CO2 ideal-gas low-temperature anchors

source.name: Ideal-gas thermochemical properties for carbon dioxide and its isotopologues
source.citation: S. A. Tashkun and A. H. Harvey, Partition Functions and Ideal-Gas Thermodynamics for Carbon Dioxide, J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 54, 023102 (2025).

transcription: Read-only subset transcribed from the official natural-abundance CO2-total.txt file. Source functions are dimensionless Cp/R, S/R, and H/(R*T); source standard-state pressure is 100000 Pa. This table is external evidence and a future low-temperature gas-segment input review, not a second CO2(g) identity or a production thermochemistry record.

quantities.meaning: standard ideal-gas isobaric heat capacity divided by source R
standard ideal-gas entropy divided by source R at 100000 Pa
standard ideal-gas enthalpy divided by source R*T
